payload.title: Operationalize the scoped audit offer and fulfillment
payload.goal: Make the existing $49 up-to-15-public-URLs audit deliverable truthful, repeatable and supportable before accepting obligations.
payload.owner_role: Designated Windows release parent assigns one admitted implementation owner; separate exact-source reviewer; existing scheduled operator retains integration/effect ownership
implementation_steps: Reuse current offer and defect-pack template; specify scope agreement, sample selection, exclusions, turnaround, one clarification round, cancellation/refund terms and capacity.
Build scoped audit jobs for visible versus structured values, variants, policies and representative catalog evidence; any uninspected feed/checkout remains explicitly unverified.
Persist intake->scope accepted->queued->evidence complete->reviewed->delivered->clarification closed with revision and private receipt references.
Generate prioritized repair backlog with reproduction and acceptance steps; require independent artifact QA before delivery; bounded clarification/support is tied to agreed scope.
Define follow-on remediation/agency QA as separately scoped proposals from actual defects and repeat demand; do not silently change free scanner claims.
tests: Fixture order of 15 URLs stays within budget/scope; over-scope or private access enters needs-input without fetching.
Reviewer can reproduce each sampled defect and distinguish real from illustrative sample.
A capacity-full state blocks paid intake while free scans and waiting list remain useful; delivery acknowledgement is reconciled once.

review.identity_requirement: Reviewer-authored record with actual reviewer identity, model/effort and host; distinct-model qualification is required for runtime/release acceptance and is not supplied by this plan.
review.exact_source: Bind immutable implementation commit, task/spec hash, artifact hashes, executed test receipts and any destination receipt. New source invalidates prior approval.
review.bounded_repairs: At most two targeted repair/review cycles; unresolved findings become a linked blocked task, preserving attempts.

acceptance: A complete sample defect pack and verifiable fulfillment run exist with observable quality gates.
An authorized real order, when available, can be delivered and supported from saved evidence; no order or satisfaction is invented.
payload.rollback: Stop new paid intake, preserve accepted obligations, restore prior offer content and reconcile or hand off open orders under their accepted terms.
payload.next_eligible_action: Prepare the scope/capacity contract and fixture fulfillment pack; keep payments disabled until CL-05 eligibility passes.

estimate.assumptions: New planning range for admitted implementation and bounded review; reuses evidenced assets; excludes observation waiting, non-delegable account work and shared-platform implementation. Not a replacement for historical Jira estimates or measured actuals.
estimate.dependency_risk: Actual delivery timing and customer acceptance require a real agreed order; planning hours exclude waiting.
